messages:
alex (docs): quick question — I opened a tiny PR to fix a broken link in /docs/getting-started and auto-merge didn't kick even though it's docs-only. anyone know why?
maya (eng): what does the branch protection require? CI passing + 1 review?
alex (docs): branch protection requires 'docs-preview' and 2 required reviews. seems heavy for link typos.
sam (product): we added 2 reviews to avoid accidental changes, but agreed it's noisy for trivial doc fixes.
maya (eng): two quick options: 1) relax protection for paths under /docs/**, or 2) add an exception bot that can auto-approve docs-only PRs.
tyler (infra): relaxing branch protection per path isn't supported by GH natively. you can use CODEOWNERS + a GitHub Action to auto-approve if changed files match a pattern.
alex (docs): can we see a sample CODEOWNERS line?
tyler (infra): yes. something like:
```
# CODEOWNERS in repo root
/docs/ @redwood-docs-team
```
That makes reviewers auto-requested, but doesn't change required-review counts.
maya (eng): for automation we use a workflow that runs on pull_request and checks changed files. if only docs files, it posts an approval via a bot account and then auto-merge can run if checks pass.
ci-bot: note: auto-merge still requires all required status checks to pass and no outstanding review requests.
alex (docs): what are the required checks? our repo has: lint, test, docs-preview. docs-preview sometimes flakes because preview infra spins up slowly.
sam (product): could we make docs-preview optional for docs-only PRs? make lint required always.
tyler (infra): yes, GH Actions + a branch protection exemption pattern: use a protected branch rule that requires checks, but a separate workflow can temporarily add a commit status 'docs-preview' = success via the bot when preview is unnecessary. alternately mark 'docs-preview' as optional and enforce via repo policy.
emily (legal): just flagging: if we allow automated approvals for docs, ensure there's an audit log and someone on-call for content-sensitive changes (legal/marketing links).
alex (docs): fair. proposal: add a 'docs-bot' workflow that: 1) detects docs-only changes, 2) runs quick link-checker, 3) posts approval and a comment with list of changed files, 4) triggers auto-merge. keeps audit trail.
maya (eng): SGTM. tyler, can infra draft the GH Action and necessary bot keys?
tyler (infra): I'll put up a draft PR with the workflow and CODEOWNERS change. it will include a safeguard: any files under /legal/ or /brand/ will opt-out and still require a human review.
alex (docs): perfect. can we also add a short docs PR template reminding folks to mark 'docs-only' in title or label? makes detection easier. :thumbsup:
sam (product): timeline?
tyler (infra): aiming to open draft by EOD tomorrow, review next week.
alex (docs): thanks all — will follow up and test with a dummy link-fix PR.
ci-bot: deployed check: docs-preview (optional) — runs on demand.
